description: Open protocol for an agent to discover and delegate work to another, opaque agent through messages, tasks and artifacts.
JSON document (usually at `/.well-known/agent-card.json`) describing an A2A agent: skills, endpoints, capabilities and required security schemes.
A unit of delegated work with a lifecycle: submitted, working, input-required or auth-required, then completed, failed, canceled or rejected.
The output of an A2A task, made of parts (text, files, structured data).
A folder with a `SKILL.md` (name, description, instructions) and optional scripts, references and assets, loaded by an agent only when relevant.
Showing an agent only names and descriptions up front and loading full instructions and files when a task needs them.
A vendor-neutral context file for coding agents: build and test commands, conventions and rules. The nearest file to the edited code wins.
Foundation under the Linux Foundation, announced in December 2025, that hosts open agent standards such as MCP, AGENTS.md, goose, A2A and Agent Skills.
